en: The dull weaving of the spirit, which no longer distinguishes anything within itself, has therefore in itself stepped beyond consciousness, which has on the other hand become clear.

The first moment of this clarity is determined in its necessity and condition by this, that pure insight, or it, which is in itself concept, actualizes itself; it does this by positing otherness or determinacy on itself.

In this way it is negative pure insight, i.e. negation of the concept; this negation is equally pure; and there has thereby come to be the pure thing, the absolute essence, which otherwise has no further determinacy.

Determined more closely, it is, as absolute concept, a distinguishing of differences that are no longer any, of abstractions or pure concepts that no longer carry themselves, but have hold and distinction only through the whole of the movement.
This distinguishing of the undistinguished consists precisely in this, that the absolute concept makes itself its own object and, over against that movement, posits itself as the essence.
Thereby this lacks the side in which the abstractions or differences are held apart, and therefore becomes pure thinking as pure thing.

- This is therefore precisely that dull, unconscious weaving of the spirit within itself, to which faith sank down when it lost the distinguished content; - it is at the same time that movement of pure self-consciousness, for which it is supposed to be the absolutely alien beyond.

For because this pure self-consciousness is the movement in pure concepts, in differences that are none, it in fact collapses into the unconscious weaving, i.e. into pure feeling or into pure thinghood.

- The concept that has estranged itself from itself - for it still stands here at the stage of this estrangement - however does not recognize this same essence of both sides, of the movement of self-consciousness and of its absolute essence, does not recognize the same essence of them, which is in fact their substance and subsistence.

Since it does not recognize this unity, the essence counts for it only in the form of the objective beyond, while the distinguishing consciousness - which in this way has the in-itself outside itself - counts for it only as a finite consciousness.
zh: 所以，精神那种沉闷的、不再在自身内区分任何东西的编织，已经在自身中越出意识之外，而意识反倒变得清晰了。
这种清晰性的第一个环节，在它的必然性和条件上是由这一点规定的：纯粹识见，或者说那个自在就是概念的东西，把自己现实化；它这样做，是因为它在自己身上设定他在或规定性。
这样一来，它就是否定的纯粹识见，也就是概念的否定；这种否定同样是纯粹的；于是就有了纯粹之物、绝对本质，而它本来没有任何进一步的规定。
更切近地规定，它作为绝对概念，是一种区分：区分那些不再是差别的差别，区分那些不再自己承载自己、而只有通过运动整体才有持存和区分的抽象或纯粹概念。
这种对无差别者的区分恰恰在于：绝对概念把自己变成自己的对象，并且面对那种运动把自己设定为本质。
这样一来，它就缺少了那个把抽象或差别彼此分开的方面，因此就成了作为纯粹之物的纯粹思维。
——所以，这恰恰就是精神在自身之内那种沉闷的、无意识的编织，信仰在失去有差别的内容时就是降到了这种编织；——它同时又是纯粹自我意识的那种运动，对纯粹自我意识来说，它应当是那个绝对陌生的彼岸。
因为这种纯粹自我意识是在纯粹概念中、在那些不成其为差别的差别中的运动，所以它实际上就坍缩为无意识的编织，也就是坍缩为纯粹感觉或纯粹物性。
——自身异化了的那个概念——因为它在这里还站在这种异化的阶段上——却不认识双方这同一个本质，即自我意识的运动与它的绝对本质的这同一个本质，不认识两者的同一个本质，而这实际上就是它们的实体和持存。
由于它不认识这种统一，所以本质在它看来就只以对象性的彼岸这一形式有效，而进行区分的意识——它用这种方式把自在置于自己之外——在它看来也只算作一种有限的意识。

en: Over that absolute essence, enlightenment itself falls into the dispute with itself that it previously had with faith, and divides into two parties.

One party proves itself as the victorious one only by splitting into two parties; for in this it shows that it possesses in itself the principle it combated, and has thereby sublated the one-sidedness in which it previously appeared.
The interest that was divided between it and the other now falls wholly within it and forgets the other, because it finds in it itself the opposition that occupies it.
At the same time, however, it has been raised into the higher, victorious element, in which it presents itself purified.
So that the discord arising within one party, which seems a misfortune, rather proves its good fortune.
zh: 围绕那个绝对本质，启蒙自己陷入了它此前与信仰有过的争执，并分成两派。
一派只有通过分裂成两派，才证明自己是获胜的那一派；因为这样一来，它就表明自己身上拥有它曾与之斗争的原则，并由此扬弃了它此前出现时的那种片面性。
那种曾在它和另一派之间分配的兴趣，现在完全落入它之中，并忘掉了另一派，因为它在自己本身中找到了那个使它忙碌的对立。
但与此同时，它已被提升到那个更高的、获胜的要素之中，并在其中展现出自己已被净化。
所以，在一派之中产生的内讧，看起来像是不幸，反倒证明了它的幸运。

en: The pure essence itself has no difference on it, hence difference comes upon it in such a way that two such pure essences emerge for consciousness, or a twofold consciousness of the same.
- The pure absolute essence is only in pure thinking, or rather it is pure thinking itself, thus absolutely beyond the finite, beyond self-consciousness, and only the negative essence.
But in this way it is precisely being, the negative of self-consciousness.

As the negative of the same, it is also related to it; it is outer being, which, related to that in which the differences and determinations fall, receives on it the differences of being tasted, seen, etc.; and the relation is sense-certainty and perception.
zh: 纯粹本质本身在它身上没有任何差别，所以差别是这样来到它身上的：有两种这样的纯粹本质为意识、或者说为同一者的二重意识而出现。
——纯粹绝对本质只存在于纯粹思维之中，或者毋宁说，它就是纯粹思维本身，因而绝对在有限者、在自我意识之外，只是否定的本质。
但这样一来，它恰恰就是存在，是自我意识的否定物。
作为自我意识的否定物，它也与自我意识相关；它是外在的存在，而它一旦与那个差别和规定落入其中的东西相关，就在自身获得那些差别：被尝到、被看到等等；而这种关系就是感性确定性和知觉。

en: If one starts from this sensuous being, into which that negative beyond necessarily passes over, but abstracts from these determinate modes of the relation of consciousness, then pure matter remains over as the dull weaving and moving within itself.

It is essential here to consider this, that pure matter is only what remains over when we abstract from seeing, feeling, tasting, etc., i.e. it is not the seen, tasted, felt, etc.; it is not the matter that is seen, felt, tasted, but the colour, a stone, a salt, etc.; it is rather the pure abstraction, and thereby the pure essence of thinking, or pure thinking itself, is present as the absolute that is not distinguished within itself, not determined, predicate-less.
zh: 如果从这种感性存在出发——那个否定的彼岸必然过渡到这种感性存在之中——但却从意识之关系的这些特定方式中抽象掉，那么剩下的就是纯粹物质，作为在自身之内那种沉闷的编织和运动。
在这里，重要的就是要看到这一点：纯粹物质只是当我们从看、感觉、尝等等中抽象掉时剩下来的东西，也就是说，它不是被看到的、被尝到的、被感觉到的东西；被看到、被感觉到、被尝到的并不是物质，而是颜色、一块石头、一种盐等等；它毋宁说是纯粹抽象，而这样一来，思维的那种纯粹本质或者说纯粹思维本身，就作为在自身内没有被区分、没有被规定、没有谓词的绝对者而存在。

en: The one enlightenment calls the absolute essence that predicate-less absolute, which is the beyond of actual consciousness in thinking, and which was the starting point; - the other calls it matter.

If they were distinguished as nature and spirit or God, then the unconscious weaving within itself would, in order to be nature, lack the wealth of unfolded life, and spirit or God would lack the self-distinguishing consciousness.

Both are, as we have seen, absolutely the same concept; the difference lies not in the matter, but purely only in the different starting point of the two formations, and in the fact that each stops at a point of its own in the movement of thinking.
If they passed over beyond this, they would meet and recognize as the same what for the one, as it claims, is an abomination, and for the other a folly.
For for the one, the absolute essence in its pure thinking, or immediately for pure consciousness, outside finite consciousness, is the negative beyond of the latter.

If it reflected on this, that on the one hand that simple immediacy of thinking is nothing other than pure being, on the other hand that which is negative for consciousness at the same time relates to this, that in the negative judgment the “ist” (copula) likewise holds both separated terms together, - then the relation of this beyond, in the determination of an outer existent, to consciousness would result, and thereby as the same as what is called pure matter; the missing moment of presence would be gained.

- The other enlightenment starts from sensuous being, then abstracts from the sensuous relation of tasting, seeing, etc., and makes it into the pure in-itself, into absolute matter, into what is neither felt nor tasted; in this way this being has become the predicate-less simple, the essence of pure consciousness; it is the pure concept as being in itself, or pure thinking within itself.

This insight does not make in its consciousness the opposite step from the existent, which is purely existent, to the thought, which is the same as the purely existent, or not from the purely positive to the purely negative; since after all the positive is purely and absolutely only through the negation, while the purely negative, as pure, is equal to itself and precisely thereby positive.

- Or both have not arrived at the concept of Cartesian metaphysics, that in itself being and thinking are the same, not at the thought that being, pure being, is not a concrete actual thing but the pure abstraction, and conversely that pure thinking, self-equality or the essence, is on the one hand the negative of self-consciousness and thereby being, on the other hand, as immediate simplicity, equally nothing other than being; thinking is thinghood, or thinghood is thinking.
zh: 一种启蒙把绝对本质称为那个无谓词的绝对者，即现实意识在思维中的彼岸，而此前正是从它出发的；——另一种启蒙则把它称为物质。
如果它们被区分为自然和精神或上帝，那么这种在自身之内的无意识编织为了成为自然，就会缺少展开了的生命的丰富性，而精神或上帝则会缺少在自身中作出区分的意识。
两者正如我们看到的，绝对是同一个概念；差别并不在于事情本身，而纯粹只在于这两种形成物不同的出发点，以及在于每一种都停留在思维运动中的一个属于自己的点上。
如果它们越过这一点，它们就会相遇，并把对一方来说——如它所声称的——是可憎之物、对另一方来说是愚蠢之举的东西认作同一个东西。
因为对一方来说，绝对本质在它的纯粹思维中、或者说直接对纯粹意识而言，是在有限意识之外的，是有限意识的否定的彼岸。
如果它反思到：一方面，思维的那种单纯的直接性无非就是纯粹存在，另一方面，对意识来说是否定的东西同时也与这一点相关，即在否定判断中那个“ist”（系词）同样把两个被分开的东西结合在一起，——那么，这个彼岸在一种外在存在者的规定中与意识的关系就会产生出来，并因此作为被称为纯粹物质的同一个东西而产生；那缺失的当前环节就会被赢获。
——另一种启蒙从感性存在出发，随后从尝、看等等的感性关系中抽象掉，并把它变成纯粹的自在、变成绝对物质、变成既不被感觉也不被尝到的东西；这样一来，这种存在就成了无谓词的单纯者、成了纯粹意识的本质；它就是作为自在存在的纯粹概念，或者说在自身之内的纯粹思维。
这种识见在它的意识中并没有迈出相反的一步：从纯粹存在者的存在者走向与纯粹存在者相同的思想，或者并没有从纯粹肯定的东西走向纯粹否定的东西；因为肯定的东西纯粹地、绝对地只有通过否定才存在，而纯粹否定的东西作为纯粹的东西则与自身相等，并正因此而是肯定的。
——或者两者都没有达到笛卡尔形而上学的那一概念，即自在的存在和思维是同一个东西，也没有达到这一思想：存在、纯粹存在并不是某种具体的现实之物，而是纯粹抽象，反过来，纯粹思维、自身等同性或本质，一方面是自我意识的否定物，并因此是存在，另一方面作为直接的单纯性，同样无非就是存在；思维就是物性，或者物性就是思维。

en: Essence here has division in it at first only in such a way that it belongs to two kinds of way of considering; on the one hand, essence must have the difference on itself, on the other, precisely therein the two ways of considering run together into one; for the abstract moments of pure being and of the negative, whereby they are distinguished, are then united in the object of these ways of considering.
– The common universal is the abstraction of pure trembling within itself, or of pure self-thinking.
This simple movement revolving on its axis must cast itself apart, because it is itself movement only in that it distinguishes its moments.
This distinguishing of the moments leaves behind the unmoved as the empty husk of pure being, which is no longer any actual thinking, no life in itself; for as difference it is all content.

But she who posits herself outside that unity is hereby the change of the moments that does not return into itself — of the in-itself, of being-for-an-other and of being-for-itself — the actuality as it is object for the actual consciousness of pure insight — utility.
zh: 本质在这里最初是这样在自身中拥有分裂的：它属于两种考察方式；一方面本质必须在自身中拥有差别，另一方面两种考察方式恰恰在这里合而为一；因为纯存在和否定物这些抽象环节——两种考察方式正是凭借它们才相互区别——这时就在这些考察方式的对象中联合起来了。
——这个共同的普遍者，就是纯然在自身中震颤、或纯然自己思维自己的那种抽象。
这种单纯的绕轴旋转的运动必定要把自己抛散开来，因为它本身之所以是运动，只是由于它把自己的诸环节区别开来。
这种对诸环节的区别，把不动者作为纯存在的空壳留下来，而这个空壳已经不再是任何现实的思维、不再是自身中的任何生命；因为这种区别作为差别就是一切内容。
但它这个把自己置于那种统一性之外的东西，由此就是不回到自身中去的诸环节的交替，——即自在、为他存在和自为存在的交替——，是现实性，就像它对纯粹识见的现实意识来说是对象那样，——是有用性。

en: However ill utility may look to faith, or to sentimentality, or also to the abstraction that calls itself speculation and fixes the in-itself for itself, it is that in which pure insight completes its realization and is itself its own object, which it now no longer disavows and which also does not have for it the value of the empty or of the pure beyond.

For pure insight is, as we saw, the existing concept itself, or the pure personality equal to itself, distinguishing itself within itself in such a way that each of the distinguished is itself pure concept, i.e. is immediately not distinguished; it is simple pure self-consciousness, which is just as much for itself as in itself in an immediate unity.

Its being-in-itself is therefore not a persisting being, but immediately ceases to be something in its difference; but such a being, which immediately has no hold, is not in itself, but essentially for an other, which is the power that absorbs it.

But this second moment, opposed to the first, to being-in-itself, vanishes just as immediately as the first; or as being only for another it is rather vanishing itself, and it is posited as the returned-into-itself, as being-for-itself.
But this simple being-for-itself, as self-sameness, is rather a being, or thereby for an other.
– This nature of pure insight in the unfolding of its moments, or pure insight as object, utility expresses.

It is something subsisting in itself, or a thing; this being-in-itself is at the same time only a pure moment; it is thus absolutely for an other, but it is just as much only for an other as it is in itself; these opposed moments have returned into the inseparable unity of being-for-itself.

But if the useful does indeed express the concept of pure insight, it is nevertheless not pure insight as such, but pure insight as representation or as its object; it is only the restless change of those moments, one of which is indeed the being-returned-into-itself itself, but only as being-for-itself, i.e. as an abstract moment that steps aside against the others.

The useful itself is not the negative essence that has these moments, in their opposition, at the same time undivided in one and the same respect, or as a thinking in itself, as they are as pure insight; the moment of being-for-itself is indeed on the useful, but not in such a way that it reaches over the other moments, the in-itself and being-for-an-other, and would thus be the self.

Pure insight therefore has, in the useful, its own concept in its pure moments as object; it is the consciousness of this metaphysics, but not yet the comprehending of it; it has not yet come to the unity of being and of the concept itself.
Because the useful still has the form of an object for it, it still has a world which it distinguishes from itself, though no longer one that is in and for itself.
But once the oppositions have stepped out onto the peak of the concept, it will be the next stage that they collapse together and enlightenment experiences the fruits of its deeds.
zh: 不管有用性在信仰眼里、在情感眼里、还是在那种自称思辨并为自己把自在固定下来的抽象看来多么糟糕，它都是纯粹识见在其中完成自己的实现、并且自己成为自己的对象的那种东西，而这个对象它现在不再否认，对它来说也不具有空洞之物或纯粹彼岸的价值。
因为正如我们看到的，纯粹识见本身就是存在着的概念，或者是自己与自己相同的纯粹人格，它在自身中这样区别自己，以致每一个被区别者本身就是纯粹概念，也就是说，是直接地未被区别的；它是单纯的纯粹自我意识，这种自我意识既是自为地又是自在地处于一种直接的统一性中。
所以它的自在存在并不是持续着的存在，而是直接地不再在它的差别中是什么东西；但这样一种直接地没有任何支撑的存在，并不是自在地存在，而本质上是为一个他者的，这个他者就是把它吸收掉的那种威力。
但这个与第一个环节、即自在存在相对立的第二个环节，和第一个环节一样直接地消失；或者说，作为仅仅为他者的存在，它反倒就是消失本身，并且它被设定为返回自身之中的东西、即自为存在。
但这个单纯的自为存在作为自身相同性，反倒是一种存在，或者由此就是为他者的存在。
——纯粹识见在展开自己的诸环节时的这种本性，或者说纯粹识见作为对象，表达出来的就是有用之物。
它是自在地持存着的东西、或者说物，这种自在存在同时只是一个纯粹环节；因此它绝对地是为一个他者的，但它同样只是为一个他者的，正如它自在地存在一样；这些相互对立的环节已经返回到自为存在那不可分离的统一性中去了。
但如果说有用之物确实表达出了纯粹识见的概念，那么它表达的毕竟不是纯粹识见本身，而是作为表象、或作为它的对象的纯粹识见；它只是那些环节的不停息的交替，这些环节中的一个虽然就是返回自身之中这件事本身，但只是作为自为存在，也就是说，只是作为一个抽象的、相对于其他环节而站到一边去的环节。
有用之物本身并不是那个否定的本质，无法把这些环节在它们的对立中同时无分离地在同一个方面、或作为自在的一种思维来拥有，就像它们作为纯粹识见那样；自为存在的环节虽然就在有用之物身上，但并不是这样：它凌驾于其他环节——自在和为他存在——之上，并由此成为自我。
所以纯粹识见在有用之物身上，把自己那个处于其纯粹环节中的概念当作对象；它是这种形而上学的意识，但还不是对这种形而上学的概念把握；它还没有达到存在和概念本身的统一。
因为有用之物对它来说还具有一个对象的形式，所以它还有一个世界，这个世界虽然已经不再是自在自为地存在着的，但它毕竟还是把这个世界与自己区别开来。
不过，一旦这些对立走上了概念的顶峰，接下来的阶段就会是：它们一同倒塌，而启蒙则经验到自己行动的果实。

en: Considered in relation to this whole sphere, the object reached: the actual world of culture had gathered itself up into the vanity of self-consciousness — into the being-for-itself that still has its confusion as its content and is still the single concept, not yet the concept universal for itself.
But returned into itself, it is pure insight — pure consciousness as the pure self or negativity, just as faith [has] the very same as pure thinking or positivity.

Faith has in that self the moment that completes it; — but perishing through this completion, it is now on the side of pure insight that we see the two moments: as the absolute essence, which is purely thought or negative, and as matter, which is the positive existent.
– This completeness still lacks that actuality of self-consciousness which belongs to the vain consciousness — the world out of which thinking raised itself to itself.
This missing element is reached in utility insofar as pure insight attained in it positive objectivity; it is thereby actual, in itself satisfied consciousness.
This objectivity now makes up its world; it has become the truth of the preceding whole world, of the ideal as well as the real world.

The first world of spirit is the spread-out realm of its self-dispersing determinate being and of the singularized certainty of itself; just as nature disperses its life into infinitely manifold shapes without the genus of these being present.
The second contains the genus and is the realm of being-in-itself or of truth, opposed to that certainty.
But the third, the useful, is the truth which is just as much the certainty of itself.
The realm of the truth of faith lacks the principle of actuality or of the certainty of itself as this single individual.
But actuality, or the certainty of itself as this single individual, lacks the in-itself.
In the object of pure insight both worlds are united.

The useful is the object insofar as self-consciousness sees through it and has in it the single certainty of itself, its enjoyment (its being-for-itself); it thus has insight into it, and this insight contains the true essence of the object (to be something seen through or for an other); it is therefore itself true knowing, and self-consciousness has just as immediately the universal certainty of itself, its pure consciousness, in this relation, in which therefore truth as well as presence and actuality are united.
Both worlds are reconciled and heaven is transplanted down onto the earth.
zh: 把这个已经达到的对象放到整个这个领域的关系中来看，教养的现实世界曾经把自己收拢进自我意识的虚浮之中，——收拢进自为存在，这种自为存在还把它的混乱当作自己的内容，并且还只是那个个别的概念，还不是自为地普遍的概念。
但它返回到自身之中，就是纯粹识见，——即作为纯粹自我或否定性的纯粹意识，正如信仰把同一个东西当作纯粹思维或肯定性一样。
信仰在那个自我中拥有使自己完整起来的环节；——但由于这种补全而走向消亡，现在就轮到纯粹识见，让我们看到那两个环节：作为绝对本质，即纯粹被思维的东西或否定物，和作为物质，即肯定的存在者。
——这种完整性还缺少那种属于虚浮意识的自我意识的现实性，——即思维由之上升到自身的那个世界。
这个缺少的东西在有用性中是这样达到的：纯粹识见在有用性身上获得了肯定的对象性；它由此成为现实的、在自身中得到满足的意识。
这种对象性现在构成了它的世界；它已经成为先前那个整体世界、即观念的世界和实在的世界的真理。
精神的第一个世界，是它的自行消散的定在、以及它自身那种个别化了的确定性的广布领域；就像自然界把自己的生命消散在无限多样的形态中，而这些形态的类却并不存在一样。
第二个世界包含类，是自在存在或真理的领域，与那种确定性相对立。
而第三个世界，即有用之物，则是那种同样也是自身确定性的真理。
信仰的真理领域缺少现实性的原则，或者说缺少作为这个个别者的自身确定性的原则。
但现实性、或者说作为这个个别者的自身确定性，缺少自在。
在纯粹识见的对象中，两个世界是联合起来的。
有用之物就是对象，因为自我意识看透了它，并在它之中拥有自身的那种个别确定性、即自己的享受（自己的自为存在）；它就以这种方式识见对象，而这种识见包含对象的真正本质（是一个被看透的东西、或者为一个他者而存在）；所以它本身就是真的知识，而自我意识同样直接地在这种关系中拥有自身的那种普遍确定性、即自己的纯粹意识，在这种关系里，真理和当前以及现实性同样都联合在一起。
两个世界已经和解，而天国则被移植到了地上。

9.en: III. Absolute Freedom and the Terror

en: Consciousness has found its concept in utility.
But it is partly still an object, partly for that very reason still an end, in whose possession consciousness does not yet immediately find itself.
Utility is still a predicate of the object, not the subject itself, or its immediate and sole actuality.

It is the same as what appeared earlier in this way, that being-for-itself has not yet proved itself to be the substance of the remaining moments, whereby the useful would immediately be nothing other than the self of consciousness and consciousness would thereby be in possession of it.

– But this withdrawal of the form of the objectivity of the useful has already happened in itself, and out of this inner upheaval there emerges the actual upheaval of actuality, the new shape of consciousness, absolute freedom.
zh: 意识在有用性中找到了自己的概念。
但它一部分还是对象，一部分正因如此还是目的，意识还没有直接处在对它的占有之中。
有用性还是对象的谓词，还不是主体本身，也不是主体直接而唯一的现实性。
这就是刚才那样显现出来的同一回事：自为存在还没有证明自己是其余环节的实体，而这样一来，有用的东西就会直接无非是意识的自我，意识也就会因此占有它。
——但是，这种对有用的东西的对象性形式的收回，已经自在地发生了，并且从这种内在的变革中产生出现实性的现实变革、意识的新形态，即绝对自由。

en: For in fact nothing more is present than an empty semblance of objectivity, which separates self-consciousness from possession.

For on the one hand, all subsistence and validity of the determinate members of the organization of the actual and the believed world has in general returned into this simple determination as into its ground and spirit; on the other hand, however, this determination no longer has anything proper to itself, it is rather pure metaphysics, pure concept, or knowledge of self-consciousness.

For from the being-in-and-for-itself of the useful as object, consciousness recognizes that its being-in-itself is essentially being-for-another; being-in-itself as the self-less is in truth the passive, or what is for another self.
But the object is for consciousness in this abstract form of pure being-in-itself, for it is pure insight, whose differences are in the pure form of concepts.

– But the being-for-itself into which being-for-another returns, the self, is not a self of what is called object that is different from the I and proper to it; for consciousness as pure insight is not a singular self, over against which the object would likewise stand as its own self, but it is the pure concept, the gazing of the self into the self, the absolute seeing of itself doubled; the certainty of it is the universal subject, and its knowing concept the essence of all actuality.

If, then, the useful was only the change of the moments that does not return into its own unity, and therefore still an object for knowledge, it ceases to be this; for knowledge is itself the movement of those abstract moments, it is the universal self, the self as much of itself as of the object, and as universal the unity of this movement returning into itself.
zh: 因为事实上现成存在的，无非是一种空洞的对象性假象，它把自我意识同占有分离开来。
因为一方面，现实世界和信仰世界的组织之各个确定分支的一切持存和有效，一般而言都已经退回到这个单纯的规定之中，把它当作自己的根据和精神；另一方面，这个规定却不再有任何属于自己的东西，它毋宁是纯粹的形而上学、纯粹的概念，或者自我意识的知识。
因为从有用的东西作为对象的自在自为存在中，意识认识到，它的自在存在本质上就是为他存在；自在存在作为无自我的东西，在真理中就是被动的东西，或者说，就是为另一个自我而存在的东西。
但对象对意识来说是以这种纯粹自在存在的抽象形式存在的，因为它是纯粹识见，它的种种差别处在概念的纯粹形式之中。
——但是，为他存在所返回于其中的自为存在，即自我，并不是一个与「我」不同的、属于那被称为对象的东西的固有自我；因为意识作为纯粹识见并不是一个单个的自我，对象会同样作为固有的自我与它相对而立，相反，它就是纯粹概念，是自我对自我的观看，是绝对的自我双重化之看；它的确定性是普遍主体，而它那知道着的概念则是一切现实性的本质。
所以，如果说有用的东西只是那些环节的不返回自身统一性的交替，因而还是知识的对象，那么它就不再是这样了；因为知识本身就是那些抽象环节的运动，它就是普遍的自我，既是它自己的自我，也是对象的自我，而作为普遍的自我，它就是这种运动返回于自身的统一。

en: Herewith spirit is present as absolute freedom; it is the self-consciousness that grasps itself, that its certainty of itself is the essence of all spiritual masses of the real as well as of the supersensuous world, or conversely, that essence and actuality is consciousness's knowledge of itself.
– It is conscious of its pure personality and therein of all spiritual reality, and all reality is only something spiritual; the world is absolutely its will, and this will is universal will.
And indeed it is not the empty thought of the will that is posited in tacit or represented consent, but really universal will, the will of all singular individuals as such.

For the will is in itself the consciousness of personality or of each one, and as this true, actual will it is to be, as the self-conscious essence of each and every personality, so that each one always does everything undividedly and that what appears as the doing of the whole is the immediate and conscious doing of each one.
zh: 这样一来，精神就作为绝对自由而现成存在；它就是那把握到自身的自我意识：它对自己的确定性是实在世界以及超感性世界的一切精神性群体的本质，或者反过来说，本质和现实性就是意识关于自身的知识。
——它意识到自己的纯粹人格性，并在此意识到一切精神性的实在性，而一切实在性都只是精神性的东西；世界对它来说绝对就是它的意志，而这个意志是普遍意志。
而且，它并不是那种被设定为默许的或被代表的同意的空洞意志思想，而是实在普遍的意志，是一切个别者作为个别者的意志。
因为意志自在地就是人格或每一个人的意识，而作为这种真正的、现实的意志，它应当作为一切人格和每一个人格的自我意识着的本质而存在，以致每一个人总是未加分割地做一切事情，而且凡是作为整体的行动而出现的东西，都是每一个人直接的、有意识的行动。

en: This undivided substance of absolute freedom ascends the throne of the world, without any power being able to offer it resistance.

For since in truth consciousness alone is the element in which the spiritual essences or powers have their substance, their whole system, which organized and maintained itself through division into masses, has collapsed, after the singular consciousness has grasped the object in such a way that it has no essence other than self-consciousness itself, or that it is absolutely the concept.

What made the concept into an existent object was its distinction into separate, subsisting masses; but in that the object becomes concept, there is nothing subsisting left in it; negativity has permeated all its moments.

It thus enters into existence in such a way that each singular consciousness raises itself out of the sphere to which it was allotted, no longer finds its essence and its work in this particularized mass, but grasps its self as the concept of the will, all masses as the essence of this will, and can hereby actualize itself only in a labor that is whole labor.

In this absolute freedom, therefore, all estates — which are the spiritual essences into which the whole articulates itself — are extinguished; the singular consciousness that belonged to such a member, and willed and accomplished in it, has sublated its limit; its end is the universal end, its language the universal law, its work the universal work.
zh: 这种绝对自由的、未被分割的实体登上了世界的王座，没有任何一种力量能够抵抗它。
因为既然在真理中唯有意识是那个元素，精神性的本质或力量就在这个元素中拥有自己的实体，那么它们的整个系统——它通过划分为各个群体而把自己组织起来并维持下来——就在个别意识这样把握了对象之后崩溃了：对象除了自我意识本身之外没有别的本质，或者说，它绝对就是概念。
使概念成为存在着的对象的东西，是它区分为各个分离的、持存着的群体；但是，当对象成为概念时，它身上就不再有任何持存着的东西了；否定性已经穿透了它的所有环节。
它就这样进入存在：每一个个别意识都从它被分配到的领域里站起来，不再在这个特殊化了的群体中寻找自己的本质和自己的作品，而是把自己的自我把握为意志的概念，把一切群体都把握为这个意志的本质，并且因此也只能在一种劳动中实现自己，而这种劳动是完整的劳动。
所以，在这种绝对自由中，一切等级——它们就是那些精神性的本质，整体把自己分成各个分支而分入其中——都被抹掉了；而那个属于这样一个分支、并在其中意愿和完成事情的个别意识，已经扬弃了自己的界限；它的目的是普遍的目的，它的语言是普遍的法律，它的作品是普遍的作品。

en: The object and the difference have here lost the meaning of utility, which was the predicate of all real being; consciousness does not begin its movement from it as from something foreign, from which it would first return into itself, but the object is for it consciousness itself; the opposition therefore consists solely in the difference of singular and universal consciousness; but the singular is immediately for itself that which only had the semblance of the opposition, it is universal consciousness and will.
The beyond of this its actuality hovers over the corpse of the vanished independence of real or believed being only as the exhalation of an insipid gas, the empty être suprême.
zh: 对象和差别在这里已经失去了有用性这个含义，而有用性曾经是一切实在存在的谓词；意识不是从对象那里开始自己的运动，仿佛从一个陌生的东西开始、然后才从它返回自身，相反，对象对意识来说就是意识本身；所以对立只在于个别意识和普遍意识的差别；但个别者对自己来说直接就是那个只具有对立之假象的东西，它就是普遍的意识和意志。
它这个现实性的彼岸，悬浮在实在的或信仰的存在那已经消失的独立性的尸体之上，只不过是一种乏味气体的散发，即空洞的 être suprême（至高存在者）。

en: After the sublation of the differentiated spiritual masses and of the limited life of individuals as well as of its two worlds, there is thus present only the movement of universal self-consciousness within itself, as an interaction of the same in the form of universality and of personal consciousness; the universal will goes into itself and is singular will, over against which the universal law and work stands.

But this singular consciousness is just as immediately conscious of itself as universal will; it is conscious that its object is law given by it and work accomplished by it; passing over into activity and creating objectivity, it therefore does not make anything singular, but only laws and state actions.
zh: 所以，在种种被区分开的精神性群体、个体那有限的生命以及它的两个世界被扬弃之后，现成存在的就只有普遍自我意识在自身之内的运动，即同一个自我意识在普遍性和人格意识这一形式中的交互作用；普遍意志进入自身，成为个别意志，而普遍的法律和作品则与这个个别意志相对而立。
但这个个别意识同样直接地意识到自己是普遍意志；它意识到，它的对象是由它给出的法律和由它完成的作品；由于它转入活动并创造出对象性，所以它所做出来的并不是任何个别的东西，而只是法律和国家行动。

en: This movement is hereby the interaction of consciousness with itself, in which it lets nothing go forth in the shape of a free object stepping over against it.

It follows from this that it can come to no positive work, neither to universal works of language nor of actuality, neither to laws and universal institutions of conscious freedom, nor to deeds and works of willing freedom.
– The work that freedom, giving itself consciousness, could make of itself, would consist in this, that as universal substance it made itself into object and abiding being.

This otherness would be the difference on it, according to which it divided itself into subsisting spiritual masses and into the members of different powers; partly that these masses would be the thought-things of a separate legislative, judicial and executive power, partly however the real essences that emerged in the real world of culture, and, if the content of the universal doing were considered more closely, the particular masses of labor, which are further distinguished as more special estates.

– The universal freedom that in this way had separated itself into its members and just thereby made itself into existent substance would thereby be free of singular individuality and would divide the multitude of individuals among its different members.

But the doing and being of personality would thereby find itself limited to one branch of the whole, to one kind of doing and being; posited into the element of being, it would receive the meaning of a determinate one; it would cease to be in truth universal self-consciousness.

In this, it cannot be deceived about actuality by the representation of obedience under self-given laws, which assigned it a part, nor by its representation in lawgiving and universal doing, – not about the actuality of giving the law itself and of accomplishing not a singular work but the universal itself; for where the self is only represented and pictured, there it is not actual; where it is stood in for, it is not.
zh: 这种运动因此就是意识与自身的交互作用，在其中，意识不以一种自由的、与它相对而立的对象的形态释放出任何东西。
由此得出：它不能达到任何肯定的作品，既不能达到语言的、也不能达到现实性的普遍作品，既不能达到有意识的自由的法律和普遍制度，也不能达到意愿着的自由的行为和作品。
——这种把意识给予自身的自由所能把自己造成的那种作品，就会在于：它作为普遍实体把自己变成对象和持存的存在。
这种他在就会是它身上的差别，按照这种差别，它把自己分成持存着的种种精神性群体，并分成各种权力的分支；这些群体一部分会是分离的立法、司法和行政权力的思想物，另一部分则会是那些在教养的实在世界中出现的实在本质，而且，如果更仔细地考察普遍行动的内容，还会是劳动的那些特殊群体，这些群体又进一步被区分为更特殊的等级。
——普遍自由如果以这种方式把自己分离为它的各个分支，并正因此把自己造成存在着的实体，那么它就会由此摆脱个别个体性，并把众多个体分派给它的各个不同分支。
但人格性的行动和存在就会由此被限制在整体的一支上，被限制在行动和存在的一种方式上；一旦被置入存在的元素之中，它就会获得一个确定之物的含义；它就不再在真理中是普遍自我意识了。
在这种情况下，它既不能靠服从自己给出的、给它指派了一份的法律这一表象，也不能靠它在立法和普遍行动中的代表，让自己在现实性上受骗，——不是在这样一件事上受骗：自己去给出法律，并且完成的不是个别的作品，而是普遍东西本身；因为，自我只是被代表、被表象的地方，它就不是现实的；在它被代理的地方，它就不存在。

en: Just as in this universal work of absolute freedom as existent substance the singular self-consciousness does not find itself, so little does it find itself in the proper deeds and individual actions of its will.

For the universal to come to a deed, it must gather itself into the one of individuality and place a singular self-consciousness at the head; for the universal will is actual will only in a self that is one.
But thereby all other singular individuals are excluded from the whole of this deed and have only a limited share in it, so that the deed would not be the deed of actual universal self-consciousness.
– No positive work or deed, therefore, can universal freedom bring forth; there remains to it only negative doing; it is only the fury of disappearance.
zh: 正如个别自我意识在这种作为定在着的实体的绝对自由的普遍作品里找不到自己，它在自己意志的真正行为和个别行动里也同样找不到自己。
普遍东西要成为一桩行为，就必须把自己收拢为个体性的一，并把一个个别自我意识置于首位；因为普遍意志只有在那个是一的自我里，才是现实的意志。
但这样一来，所有其他个别者都被排除在这桩行为的整体之外，在其中只占有有限的一份，以致这行为就不会是现实普遍自我意识的行为。
——所以，普遍自由不能产生任何肯定的作品或行为；留给它的只有否定的行动；它只是消失的复仇女神。

en: But the highest actuality, and the one most opposed to universal freedom, or rather the only object that still comes to be for it, is the freedom and singularity of actual self-consciousness itself.

For that universality, which does not let itself come to the reality of organic articulation and has the purpose of preserving itself in undivided continuity, at the same time distinguishes itself in itself, because it is movement or consciousness in general.

And indeed, by virtue of its own abstraction, it splits into equally abstract extremes, into the simple, inflexible, cold universality and into the discrete, absolute, hard brittleness and obstinate punctuality of actual self-consciousness.

After it has finished with the annihilation of real organization and now subsists for itself, this is its only object – an object that no longer has any other content, possession, determinate being and external extension, but is only this knowledge of itself as absolutely pure and free singular self.
What it can be grasped by is solely its abstract determinate being in general.

– The relation of these two, then, since they are indivisibly absolute for themselves and therefore cannot send any part into the middle by which they might link themselves together, is the wholly unmediated pure negation, and indeed the negation of the singular as existent in the universal.

The only work and deed of universal freedom is therefore death, and indeed a death that has no inner extent and fulfilment; for what is negated is the unfulfilled point of the absolutely free self; it is therefore the coldest, flattest death, with no more meaning than the cutting through of a cabbage head or a gulp of water.
zh: 但最高的、与普遍自由最相对立的现实性，或者毋宁说，对它来说还会出现的唯一对象，就是现实自我意识本身的自由和个别性。
因为那种普遍性不允许自己达到有机划分的实在性，并且以在未分割的连续性中保存自己为目的，它同时又在自身内区分自己，因为它就是运动，或者说就是一般的意识。
而且，正因为它自己的抽象，它把自己分裂为同样抽象的两个极端，分裂为单纯的、不可弯曲的、冷的普遍性，以及现实自我意识那种离散的、绝对的、坚硬的僵脆和执拗的点状性。
在它完成了对实在组织的消灭、如今自为地持存之后，这就是它唯一的对象——一个不再有任何其他内容、占有、定在和外在延展的对象，相反，它只是这种关于自己作为绝对纯粹而自由的个别自我的知识。
它能够被把握到的地方，就只有它一般说来那种抽象的定在。
——所以，这两者的关系——既然它们不可分割地绝对自为，因而不能把任何部分送到中间去，以便把自己联结起来——就是完全无中介的纯粹否定，而且是个别者作为存在者在普遍东西里的否定。
所以，普遍自由唯一的作品和行为就是死亡，而且是一种没有内在范围和充实的死亡；因为被否定的东西，就是绝对自由的自那个没有得到充实的点；所以它是最冷的、最平淡的死亡，其含义不超过砍开一颗卷心菜的头或者喝一口水。

en: In the flatness of this syllable consists the wisdom of the government, the understanding of the universal will, to accomplish itself.
The government is itself nothing other than the self-fixing point or the individuality of the universal will.
It, a willing and accomplishing that proceeds from one point, wills and accomplishes at the same time a determinate arrangement and action.

Thereby it excludes, on the one hand, the remaining individuals from its deed, and on the other hand it thereby constitutes itself as one that is a determinate will and is thereby opposed to the universal will; it can therefore present itself in no other way than as a faction.

Only the victorious faction is called government, and precisely in its being a faction there lies immediately the necessity of its downfall; and that it is government, this conversely makes it a faction and guilty.

If the universal will holds to its actual acting as to the crime that it commits against it, then it has over against this nothing determinate and external by which the guilt of the will opposed to it would present itself; for over against it, as the actual universal will, stands only the unreal pure will, the intention.

Becoming suspect therefore takes the place of being guilty, or has the meaning and effect of being guilty, and the external reaction against this actuality that lies in the simple inner of the intention consists in the dry annihilation of this existent self, from which nothing else is to be taken away than only its being itself.
zh: 政府的智慧，普遍意志把自己实现出来的知性，就在于这个音节的平淡无奇。
政府本身无非是那个把自己固定下来的点，或者说，是普遍意志的个体性。
它作为一种从一个点出发的意愿和完成，同时意愿并完成一种确定的安排和行动。
它由此一方面把其余的个体排除在自己的行为之外，另一方面又由此把自己构造成这样一个意志：它是确定的意志，并因此与普遍意志相对立；所以它绝不能把自己表现为别的样子，只能表现为一个派系。
只有胜利的派系才叫政府，而正因为它是一个派系，其中就直接包含着它覆灭的必然性；而它是政府这一点，反过来又使它成为派系并有罪。
如果普遍意志抓住它现实的行动，把它当作它对自己犯下的罪行，那么它对此拿不出任何确定的、外在的东西，来把那个与它相对立的意志的罪过表现出来；因为与它这个现实的普遍意志相对而立的，只是那不现实的纯粹意志，即意图。
所以，变得可疑就代替了有罪，或者说具有有罪的含义和效果，而这种针对那种存在于意图的单纯内部之中的现实性的外在反应，则在于干巴巴地消灭这个存在着的自我，在这个自我身上，除了它自己的存在本身之外，再没有什么别的东西可以拿掉。

en: In this its own proper work, absolute freedom becomes an object to itself, and self-consciousness experiences what it is.
In itself it is precisely this abstract self-consciousness, which annihilates in itself all difference and all subsistence of difference.
As this, it is the object to itself; the terror of death is the intuition of this its negative essence.

But the absolutely free self-consciousness finds this its reality quite different from what its concept of itself was: namely, that the universal will is only the positive essence of personality, and that personality in it knows itself only as positive or as preserved.

Rather, here, for it — which as pure insight absolutely separates its positive and negative essence, the predicate-less Absolute as pure thought and as pure matter — the absolute transition from the one into the other is present in its actuality.

– The universal will, as absolutely positive actual self-consciousness, because it is this self-conscious actuality raised to pure thought or to abstract matter, turns into the negative essence and proves itself to be likewise a sublating of self-thinking, or of self-consciousness.
zh: 在它这个固有的作品里，绝对自由成为自己的对象，而自我意识经验到它是什么。
自在地，它正是这种抽象的自我意识，它在自身内消灭了一切差别和差别的一切持存。
作为这种自我意识，它就是自己的对象；死亡的恐怖就是对它这个否定本质的直观。
但是，绝对自由的自我意识发现它这个实在性，与它关于自己本身的概念曾经所是的样子完全不同：也就是说，普遍意志只是人格的肯定本质，而人格在它之中只知道自己是肯定的，或者说知道自己被保持着。
相反，在这里，对它来说——它作为纯粹识见，把自己肯定的本质和否定的本质、把那无谓词的绝对者作为纯粹思维和作为纯粹物质，绝对地分离开来——从一方到另一方的绝对过渡，就在它的现实性中现成存在。
——普遍意志作为绝对肯定的、现实的自我意识，因为它就是这种被提升为纯粹思维或抽象物质的、自我意识着的现实性，所以转化为否定的本质，并表明自己同样是对自我思维、或者说对自我意识的扬弃。

en: Absolute freedom therefore has, as the pure self-equality of the universal will, negation, and thereby difference in general, upon it, and develops this again as actual difference.

For pure negativity has, in the self-equal universal will, the element of subsistence or the substance in which its moments realize themselves; it has the matter which it can use for its determinacy; and insofar as this substance has shown itself as the negative for singular consciousness, there forms itself again the organization of the spiritual masses, to which the multitude of individual consciousnesses is allotted.

These, which have felt the fear of their absolute lord, death, again put up with the negation and the differences, order themselves under the masses, and return to a divided and limited work, but thereby to their substantial actuality.
zh: 所以，绝对自由作为普遍意志的纯粹自身等同，身上就有否定，并因此有一般的差别，而它又把这种差别重新发展为现实的差别。
因为纯粹否定性在自身等同的普遍意志身上拥有持存的元素或实体，它的那些环节就在其中实现自己；它拥有物质，可以把它用于自己的规定性；而既然这个实体已经表明自己是对于个别意识而言的否定东西，那么精神性群体的组织就又形成起来，众多个别意识被分配给这些群体。
这些已经感受到自己绝对主人即死亡的恐惧的意识，又重新忍受否定和种种差别，把自己归入各个群体之下，并回到一种被分割的、有限的作品，但由此回到它们实体性的现实性。

en: Spirit would be hurled back out of this tumult to its starting point, the ethical and real world of culture, which has only been refreshed and rejuvenated by the fear of the Lord that has come into men's minds again.

Spirit would have to run through this cycle of necessity anew and repeat it over and over, if only the complete interpenetration of self-consciousness and substance were the result – an interpenetration in which self-consciousness, which has experienced the power of its universal essence as negative over against it, would want to know and find itself not as this particular but only as universal, and could therefore also endure the objective actuality of the universal spirit that excludes it as particular.

– But in absolute freedom it was neither consciousness, which is sunk in manifold determinate being or which fixes determinate purposes and thoughts for itself, nor an externally valid world, whether of actuality or of thought, that stood in interaction with one another; rather, the world purely and simply in the form of consciousness, as universal will, and likewise self-consciousness drawn together out of all extended determinate being or manifold purpose and judgment into the simple self.
The culture that it attains in its interaction with that essence is therefore the most sublime and the last: to see its pure, simple actuality immediately vanish and pass over into the empty nothing.

In the world of culture itself it does not come to intuit its negation or estrangement in this form of pure abstraction; rather its negation is the fulfilled one, either honor or wealth, which it wins in place of the self from which it estranged itself, or the language of spirit and of insight that the torn consciousness attains; or it is the heaven of faith or the useful of enlightenment.

All these determinations are lost in the loss that the self undergoes in absolute freedom; its negation is the meaningless death, the pure terror of the negative, which has nothing positive, nothing fulfilling in it.

– At the same time, however, this negation in its actuality is not something foreign; it is neither the universal necessity lying in the beyond, in which the ethical world perishes, nor the individual contingency of one's own possession or of the caprice of the possessor, on which the torn consciousness sees itself dependent – rather it is the universal will, which in this its last abstraction has nothing positive and can therefore give nothing back for the sacrifice; – but precisely for that reason it is immediately one with self-consciousness, or it is the purely positive because it is the purely negative; and the meaningless death, the unfulfilled negativity of the self, turns over in the inner concept into absolute positivity.
For consciousness, its immediate unity with the universal will, its demand to know itself as this determinate point in the universal will, is transformed into the absolutely opposite experience.

What vanishes for it therein is abstract being, or the immediacy of the substance-less point, and this vanished immediacy is the universal will itself, as which it now knows itself, in so far as it is sublated immediacy, in so far as it is pure knowing or pure will.

Thereby it knows it as itself and itself as essence, but not as the immediately existing essence, neither it as the revolutionary government or as the anarchy striving to constitute anarchy, nor itself as the center of this faction or of the one opposed to it; rather the universal will is its pure knowing and willing, and it is universal will as this pure knowing and willing.
It does not lose itself therein, for pure knowing and willing is rather it, as the atomic point of consciousness.
It is therefore the interaction of pure knowing with itself; pure knowing as essence is the universal will; but this essence is absolutely only pure knowing.

Self-consciousness is therefore the pure knowing of the essence as pure knowing; further, it as singular self is only the form of the subject or of actual doing, which is known by it as form; likewise, for it objective actuality, being, is absolutely self-less form, for otherwise it would be the not-known; but this knowing knows knowing as the essence.
zh: 精神就会从这场骚乱中被抛回到它的出发点，即伦理的和实在的教养世界，而这个世界通过重新进入人心的对主的畏惧，只是得到了刷新并重新变得年轻。
精神就不得不重新经历并且永远重复这个必然性的循环，如果结果只是自我意识和实体的完全互相渗透——在这种渗透中，自我意识已经经验到自己的普遍本质那种对它起否定作用的力量，它就不愿知道自己和发现自己为这个特殊者，而只愿知道自己和发现自己为普遍者，因而也能够忍受普遍精神那种把它作为特殊者排除在外的、对象性的现实性。
——但在绝对自由中，既不是沉入杂多定在之中、或为自己设定确定的目的和思想的意识，也不是一个外在有效的世界，不论是现实性的世界还是思想的世界，彼此处于交互作用之中，相反，是纯粹处在意识形式之中的、作为普遍意志的世界，以及同样从一切展开的定在或杂多的目的和判断中收拢到单纯自我里的自我意识。
因此，它在与那个本质的交互作用中获得的教养，就是最崇高、最后的教养，即看到自己纯粹而单纯的现实性直接消失并转化为空洞的无。
在教养世界本身中，它还不会把自己的否定或异化当作这种纯粹抽象的形式来直观；相反，它的否定是充实了的否定，或者是它取代自己与之相异化的那个自我而赢得的荣誉或财富，或者是撕裂的意识所获得的、精神与识见的语言；或者它是信仰的天国，或者是启蒙的有用之物。
所有这些规定都在自我于绝对自由中所遭受的那种丧失中丧失了；它的否定是无意义的死亡，是否定者纯粹的恐怖，而这否定者自身中没有任何肯定性的东西，也没有任何充实性的东西。

——但与此同时，这种否定在它的现实性中并不是一个异己的东西；它既不是伦理世界在其中沉沦的那个普遍的、处在彼岸的必然性，也不是撕裂的意识发现自己所依赖的、自己占有的个别偶然或占有者脾气的个别偶然，——相反，它是普遍意志，这普遍意志在它这种最后的抽象中没有任何肯定性的东西，因此不能为牺牲拿回任何东西；——但正因如此，它无中介地与自我意识是一回事，或者说，它是纯粹肯定性的东西，因为它是纯粹否定性的东西；而无意义的死亡、自我未得到充实的否定性，就在内在的概念中转变为绝对的肯定性。
对意识来说，它与普遍意志的直接统一，它要求自己在普遍意志中知道自己就是这个确定的点，就转变为绝对相反的经验。
在其中对它消失的东西，是抽象的存在，或者说，是无实体之点的直接性，而这个已经消失的直接性就是普遍意志本身，意识现在知道自己就是这个普遍意志，因为它是被扬弃的直接性，因为它是纯粹的知识或纯粹的意志。
由此，它把普遍意志知道为自己，把自己知道为本质，但不是知道为直接存在着的本质，它既不把普遍意志当作革命政府，也不把它当作力求构成无政府状态的无政府状态，既不把自己当作这个派系的中心，也不把自己当作与它相对立的那个派系的中心，相反，普遍意志就是它纯粹的知识和意愿，而它作为这种纯粹的知识和意愿就是普遍意志。
它在此中并没有失去自己，因为纯粹的知识和意愿毋宁就是它，作为意识的原子之点。
所以，它是纯粹知识与自身的交互作用；纯粹知识作为本质就是普遍意志；但这个本质绝对只是纯粹知识。
所以，自我意识就是关于作为纯粹知识的本质的纯粹知识；其次，它作为个别的自我，只是主体或现实行动的形式，而这形式被它作为形式来知道；同样，对它来说，对象性的现实性、存在，绝对是无自我的形式，因为否则它就是未被知道的东西；但这种知识却把知识知道为本质。

en: Absolute freedom has therefore balanced the opposition of the universal and the singular will with itself; the self-estranged spirit, driven to the peak of its opposition, in which pure willing and the purely willing one are still distinguished, reduces it to transparent form and finds itself therein.

– Just as the realm of the actual world passes over into the realm of faith and insight, so absolute freedom passes from its self-destroying actuality into another land of self-conscious spirit, in which, in this unreality, it counts as the true, on the thought of which spirit refreshes itself, in so far as it is and remains thought and knows this being enclosed in self-consciousness as the perfect and complete essence.
The new shape of the moral spirit has arisen.
zh: 所以，绝对自由已经使普遍意志和个别意志的对立与自身得到了平衡；自身异化了的精神被驱赶到自己对立的高峰，在这种对立中，纯粹的意愿和纯粹意愿着的东西还有所区别，它把这种对立降低为透明的形式，并在其中发现自己。
——正如现实世界的王国过渡到信仰和识见的王国，绝对自由也从它自我毁灭着的现实性过渡到自我意识着的精神的另一片土地，在那里，它在这种非现实性中作为真的东西有效，精神靠对这个真的东西的思想来滋养自己，因为它是思想并且始终是思想，并且把这种封闭在自我意识中的存在知道为完美而完整的本质。
道德精神的新形态已经产生。

24.en: C. Spirit Certain of Itself. Morality
24.zh: C. 自身确定的精神。道德

en: The ethical world showed the spirit that had only departed within it, the singular self, as its fate and its truth.
But this person of right has its substance and fulfillment outside it.

The movement of the world of culture and of faith sublates this abstraction of the person, and through completed estrangement, through the highest abstraction, substance becomes for the self of spirit first the universal will and finally its own property.

Here, then, knowing seems at last to have become completely equal to its truth, for its truth is this knowing itself, and all opposition of both sides has disappeared, and indeed not for us or in itself, but for self-consciousness itself.
For it has become master over the opposition of consciousness itself.

This rests on the opposition of the certainty of itself and the object; but now the object is for it the certainty of itself, knowing – just as the certainty of itself as such no longer has purposes of its own and is thus no longer in determinacy, but is pure knowing.
zh: 伦理世界把在它之中仅仅消逝了的精神、即个别的自我，显示为它的命运和它的真理。
但这种法权人格的实体和充实却在它之外。
教养世界和信仰世界的运动扬弃了人格的这种抽象，而通过完成了的异化、通过最高的抽象，对精神的自我来说，实体首先成为普遍意志，最终成为它自己的财产。
所以在这里，知识似乎终于与它的真理完全等同了，因为它的真理就是这种知识本身，而双方的一切对立都已消失，而且不是对我们来说或自在地消失，而是对自我意识本身来说消失。
因为它已经成为意识本身之对立的主人。
这一点基于它对自己的确定性与对象之间的对立；但现在，对象对它自己来说就是它对自己的确定性，即知识——正如它对自己的确定性本身不再有自己特有的目的，因此不再处在规定性之中，而是纯粹的知识。

en: The knowing of self-consciousness is therefore substance itself for it.
It is for it just as immediate as absolutely mediated, in an undivided unity.

Immediately – as the ethical consciousness, it itself knows and does duty and belongs to it as its own nature; but it is not character as that is, which on account of its immediacy is a determinate spirit, belongs to only one of the ethical essences, and has the side of not being in knowledge.

– It is absolute mediation, like the self-cultivating and the believing consciousness; for it is essentially the movement of the self to sublate the abstraction of immediate determinate being and to become universal for itself – but neither through pure estrangement and the tearing apart of its self and of actuality, nor through flight.

Rather, it is immediately present to itself in its substance, for that is its knowing, it is the intuited pure certainty of itself; and precisely this immediacy, which is its own actuality, is all actuality, for the immediate is being itself, and as the pure immediacy purified through absolute negativity, it is pure, it is being in general or all being.
zh: 所以，自我意识的知识对它来说就是实体本身。
实体对它来说同样既是直接的，又是绝对被中介的，处在一种未分离的统一之中。
直接地——它像伦理意识那样，自己知道并履行义务，并且作为自己的本性而属于义务；但它不像伦理意识那样是性格，伦理意识由于自己的直接性而是一个特定的精神，只属于伦理本质性中的一种，并且有着不在知识中的那一面。
——它是绝对的中介，就像自身教养着的意识和信仰着的意识那样；因为它本质上就是自我的运动，即扬弃直接定在的抽象并使自己成为普遍者，——但不是通过纯粹的异化及其自我与现实性的撕裂，也不是通过逃避。
相反，它直接地在自己的实体中对自己在场，因为实体就是它的知识，就是被直观到的、它对自己的纯粹确定性；而这种直接性，即它自己的现实性，就是一切现实性，因为直接的东西就是存在本身，而作为通过绝对否定性得到纯化的、纯粹的直接性，它就是纯粹的存在，就是一般存在或一切存在。

en: The absolute essence is therefore not exhausted in the determination of being the simple essence of thinking, but it is all actuality, and this actuality is only as knowledge; what consciousness would not know would have no sense and can be no power for it; into its knowing will all objectivity and world have withdrawn.
It is absolutely free in this, that it knows its freedom, and precisely this knowledge of its freedom is its substance and purpose and only content.
zh: 所以绝对本质并不穷尽于这个规定，即它是思维的单纯本质，相反，它就是一切现实性，而这种现实性只是作为知识而存在；凡是意识不知道的东西，就根本没有意义，也不可能对它成为任何威力；一切对象性和世界都已经退回到它那个知道着的意志之中。
它的绝对自由就在于它知道自己的自由，而正是这种对自己自由的知识，就是它的实体、目的和唯一的内容。

en: Self-consciousness knows duty as the absolute essence; it is bound only through duty, and this substance is its own pure consciousness; duty cannot receive the form of something foreign for it.
But thus closed up in itself, moral self-consciousness is not yet posited and considered as consciousness.
The object is immediate knowledge, and so purely penetrated by the self is it not an object.
But as essentially mediation and negativity, it has in its concept the relation to an otherness and is consciousness.
This otherness is on the one hand, because duty constitutes its only essential purpose and object, a wholly meaningless actuality for it.

But because this consciousness is so completely closed up in itself, it comports itself toward this otherness as completely free and indifferent, and determinate being is therefore on the other hand a determinate being wholly let free by self-consciousness, one that likewise relates only to itself; the freer self-consciousness becomes, the freer too the negative object of its consciousness.

It is thereby a world completed in itself into its own individuality, an independent whole of laws of its own as well as an independent course and free realization of these, – a nature in general whose laws as well as its doing belong to it itself, as to an essence that is unconcerned about moral self-consciousness, just as the latter is unconcerned about it.
zh: 自我意识知道义务就是绝对本质；它只通过义务而受约束，而这个实体就是它自己的纯粹意识；义务不可能对它取得一个异己之物的形式。
但这样封闭在自身之中的道德自我意识，还没有被设定为、也没有被当作意识来看待。
对象是直接的知识，而它如此纯粹地被自我所渗透，以致它并不是对象。
但它本质上就是中介和否定性，所以在自己的概念中具有对一个他在的关系，并且是意识。
这个他在一方面——因为义务构成了它唯一本质的目的和对象——对它来说是一种完全没有意义的现实性。
但因为这种意识如此完全地封闭在自身之中，所以它对这个他在的态度就完全自由、完全无动于衷，而定在因此另一方面就是一种被自我意识完全放开的、同样只与自身发生关系的定在；自我意识越是自由，它意识的那个否定对象也就越是自由。
它由此成为一个在自身中向自己的个体性完成起来的世界，一个由独特规律构成的独立整体，以及这些规律的独立进程和自由实现，——一个一般的自然界，它的规律和它的行动一样都属于它自己，即属于这样一个本质：它不关心道德自我意识，正如道德自我意识也不关心它一样。

en: From this determination onward a moral world-view takes shape, which consists in the relation of moral being-in-and-for-itself and natural being-in-and-for-itself.

This relation has as its ground both the complete indifference and the own independence of nature and of moral purposes and activity over against each other, and on the other side the consciousness of the sole essentiality of duty and of the complete non-independence and non-essence of nature.
The moral world-view contains the development of the moments that are present in this relation of such wholly contradictory presuppositions.
zh: 从这种规定开始，就形成了一种道德世界观，它存在于道德的自在自为存在和自然的自在自为存在的关系之中。
这种关系的基础，一方面是自然与道德目的和活动彼此之间完全的漠不关心和各自的独立性，另一方面则是关于义务具有唯一本质性、以及自然完全无独立性和无本质性的意识。
道德世界观包含着那些环节的展开，这些环节就存在于这种由如此完全相互冲突的前提所构成的关系之中。

en: First, then, moral consciousness in general is presupposed; duty counts for it as the essence — for it, which is actual and active and in its actuality and deed fulfills duty.

But for this moral consciousness the presupposed freedom of nature is at the same time there; or it experiences that nature is unconcerned about giving it the consciousness of the unity of its actuality with nature's, and thus lets it become happy perhaps, and perhaps not.

Unmoral consciousness, by contrast, perhaps coincidentally finds its realization, where moral consciousness sees only occasion for acting, but through it does not see the happiness of the execution and of the enjoyment of the completion granted to it.

It therefore finds rather ground for complaint about such a condition of the inadequacy of itself and of determinate being, and about the injustice that restricts it to having its object only as pure duty, but denies it to see this object and itself realized.
zh: 所以首先，道德意识一般是被设定为前提的；义务对它来说就是本质，对它这个现实的、行动着的、并在自己的现实性和行为中履行义务的意识来说就是本质。
但同时对这种道德意识来说，也有被设定为前提的自然的自由；或者说，它经验到自然并不关心是否给它那种关于它的现实性与自然的现实性之统一的意识，因此也许让它得到幸福，也许不让。
相反，不道德的意识也许碰巧会找到自己的实现，而在那里，道德意识只看到行动的诱因，却看不到通过行动而落到它头上的执行和享受完成的那种幸福。
所以它反倒找到了抱怨的理由，抱怨它和定在彼此这样不相适合的状态，抱怨那种不公正：这种不公正把它限制为只把对象当作纯粹义务来拥有，却不让它看到这个对象和自己得到实现。

en: Moral consciousness cannot renounce happiness and omit this moment from its absolute purpose.

The purpose that is expressed as pure duty has essentially this about it, to contain this single self-consciousness; individual conviction and the knowledge of it made up an absolute moment of morality.

This moment on the purpose that has become objective, on fulfilled duty, is the single consciousness that intuits itself as realized, or the enjoyment that hereby lies in the concept — to be sure not immediately in that of morality considered as disposition, but in the concept of its realization.
But hereby it also lies in morality as disposition; for this disposition aims not at remaining disposition in opposition to acting, but at acting or realizing itself.

The purpose, expressed as the whole with the consciousness of its moments, is therefore this: that fulfilled duty be just as much purely moral action as realized individuality, and that nature, as the side of singularity over against the abstract purpose, be one with it.
– As necessary as the experience of the disharmony of both sides is, because nature is free, so too is duty alone the essential, and nature over against it the selfless.
That whole purpose that the harmony makes up contains actuality itself in itself.
It is at the same time the thought of actuality.

The harmony of morality and of nature, or — since nature comes into consideration only insofar as consciousness experiences its unity with it — the harmony of morality and of happiness, is thought as necessarily being, or it is postulated.
For demanding expresses that something is thought as being which is not yet actual; a necessity not of the concept as concept, but of being.
But the necessity is at the same time essentially the relation through the concept.

The demanded being therefore does not belong to the representing of contingent consciousness, but lies in the concept of morality itself, whose true content is the unity of the pure and the single consciousness; to the latter it belongs that this unity be for it as an actuality — which in the content of the purpose is happiness, but in its form is determinate being in general.

– This demanded determinate being, or the unity of both, is therefore not a wish, or, considered as purpose, not one whose attainment would still be uncertain, but it is a requirement of reason, or the immediate certainty and presupposition of the same.
zh: 道德意识不能放弃幸福，也不能把这一环节从它的绝对目的中略去。
那个被表述为纯粹义务的目的，本质上就带有这一点：它包含着这个个别的自我意识；个体的确信以及对这种确信的知识，构成了道德的一个绝对环节。
这一环节在已经成为对象的目的身上、在得到履行的义务身上，就是那个把自己直观为得到了实现的个别意识，或者说就是享受——这种享受因此就处在概念之中，虽然并不是直接处在被当作意向来看的道德的概念之中，而是处在道德之实现的概念之中。
但这样一来，它也作为意向而处在道德之中；因为这种意向所追求的，不是作为与行动相对立的意向停留下去，而是去行动，或者说去实现自己。
所以，这个作为整体、连同对其诸环节的意识一起被表述出来的目的，就是这样一点：得到履行的义务既是纯粹道德的行动，又是实现了的个体性，而自然作为与抽象目的相对立的个别性那一面，则与这个目的合而为一。
——双方不和谐的经验是必然的，因为自然是自由的，同样，只有义务才是本质性的东西，而与它相对的自然则是无自我的东西。
那个构成和谐的整体目的，本身就把现实性包含在自身之中。
它同时就是现实性的思想。
道德与自然的和谐，或者说——由于自然只有在意识经验到它与自己的统一时才会被考虑——道德与幸福的和谐，是被设想为必然存在着的，或者说，它是被公设的。
因为要求所表达的是：有某种还没有成为现实的东西被设想为存在着的；这是一种必然性，不是概念作为概念的必然性，而是存在的必然性。
但这种必然性同时本质上就是通过概念而形成的关系。
所以被要求的这种存在并不属于偶然意识的表象，而是就在道德本身的概念之中，这个概念的真实内容就是纯粹意识和个别意识的统一；属于后一种意识的则是这一点：这种统一对它是作为一种现实性而存在的——这种现实性在目的的内容中是幸福，而在它的形式中则是一般的定在。
——所以，这种被要求的定在、或者说双方的统一，并不是一个愿望，或者作为目的来看，也不是那种其达到还仍然不确定的目的，而是理性的一种要求，或者说，是理性的直接确定性和前提。

en: That first experience and this postulate is not the only one; rather, a whole circle of postulates opens up.
For nature is not merely this wholly free, external mode in which, as in a pure object, consciousness would have to realize its end.
This consciousness is in itself essentially such that this other free actual thing is for it, i.e. it is itself something contingent and natural.

This nature, which is its own, is sensuousness, which in the shape of willing, as drives and inclinations, has for itself its own determinate essence or singular ends, and is therefore opposed to the pure will and its pure end.
But over against this opposition, for pure consciousness it is rather the relation of sensuousness to it, its absolute unity with it, that is the essence.

Both, pure thinking and the sensuousness of consciousness, are in themselves one consciousness, and pure thinking is precisely that for which and in which this pure unity is; but for it as consciousness there is the opposition of itself and the drives.

In this conflict of reason and sensuousness, it is the essence for the former that it dissolve itself and that as result the unity of both emerge, which is not that original unity, that both are in one individual, but is one that emerges from the known opposition of the two.

Only such a unity is actual morality, for in it is contained the opposition through which the self is consciousness, or is first actual and in fact a self and at the same time universal; or in it that mediation is expressed which, as we see, is essential to morality.

– Since, among the two moments of the opposition, sensuousness is absolutely the otherness or the negative, while the pure thinking of duty is the essence, of which nothing can be given up, the produced unity seems able to come about only through the sublation of sensuousness.

But since it is itself a moment of this becoming, the moment of actuality, one will for the time being have to content oneself, as regards the unity, with the expression that sensuousness be in accordance with morality.
– This unity is likewise a postulated being; it is not present; for what is present is consciousness, or the opposition of sensuousness and pure consciousness.

But at the same time it is not an in-itself like the first postulate, in which free nature makes up one side and the harmony of the same with moral consciousness therefore falls outside the latter; rather, nature here is the one that is in consciousness itself, and here it is a matter of morality as such, of a harmony that is the own of the acting self; therefore consciousness has to bring it about itself and to make constant progress in morality.
But the completion of it is to be postponed into the infinite; for if it really came about, moral consciousness would sublate itself.
For morality is only moral consciousness as the negative essence, for whose pure duty sensuousness has only a negative meaning, is only not in accordance.
But in the harmony, morality as consciousness, or its actuality, disappears, just as in moral consciousness, or actuality, its harmony disappears.
The completion is therefore not actually to be attained, but only to be thought as an absolute task, i.e. as one that remains absolutely a task.

At the same time, however, its content is to be thought as something that absolutely must be and does not remain a task; whether one now represents consciousness to oneself in this goal as wholly sublated, or not; how one is actually to take it can no longer be clearly distinguished in the dark distance of infinity, to which the attainment of the goal is for that very reason to be postponed.

Properly speaking, it will have to be said that the determinate representation is not to be of interest and is not to be sought, because this leads to contradictions – contradictions of a task that is to remain a task and yet be fulfilled, of a morality that is to be no longer consciousness, no longer actual.
But through the consideration that completed morality would contain a contradiction, the holiness of the moral essence would suffer and absolute duty would appear as something unreal.
zh: 那第一个经验和这个公设并不是唯一的，毋宁说，有整整一圈的公设展现出来。
因为自然并不只是这种完全自由的外在方式，在其中，意识作为一个纯粹对象必须实现自己的目的。
这种意识在它自身那里本质上就是这样的意识：那另一个自由的现实之物是为它的，也就是说，它自己是一个偶然的和自然的东西。
这种自然，对它来说就是它自己的自然，就是感性，感性在意欲这个形态中，作为冲动和偏好，自为地拥有自己特定的本质或者个别目的，因而与纯粹意志及其纯粹目的相对立。
但是，面对这种对立，对纯粹意识来说，反倒是感性对它的关系、感性与它的绝对统一才是本质。
两者，即纯粹思维和意识的感性，自在地是同一个意识，而纯粹思维恰恰就是这种意识：这纯粹的统一是为它并且在它之中存在的；但是对它作为意识而言，却存在着它自身与各种冲动之间的对立。
在理性与感性的这种冲突中，对理性来说，本质就在于：冲突自行消解，并且作为结果产生出两者的统一，而这种统一不是那原初的统一，即两者处在同一个个体之中，而是一种从两者被认识到的对立中产生出来的统一。
只有这样的统一才是现实的道德，因为在它之中包含着那种对立，自我通过这种对立才是意识，或者说才第一次成为现实的、实际上确确实实是自我、同时又是普遍的东西；或者说，在它之中表达出了那种中介，这种中介如我们所看到的，对道德来说是本质性的。
——既然在对立的两个环节中，感性绝对地是他在或否定的东西，而义务的纯粹思维则是本质，从这种本质上不能放弃任何东西，那么产生出来的统一看来只有通过扬弃感性才能形成。
但是，既然感性本身是这种变易的环节，是现实性的环节，那么对于这种统一，人们暂时只能满足于这样的说法：感性是合乎道德的。
——这种统一同样是一种被公设的存在，它并不现成存在；因为现成存在着的，是意识，或者说，是感性与纯粹意识的对立。
但是，它同时并不像第一个公设那样是一个自在，在第一个公设中，自由的自然构成一面，因而它与道德意识的和谐落在道德意识之外；相反，这里的自然则是在意识自身那里[存在]的那种自然，而这里关乎的是道德本身，是一种和谐，这种和谐是行动着的自我的自家和谐；因此，意识必须自己把它造成，并在道德中不断取得进步。
但是，这种统一的完成必须被推向无限；因为如果它真的出现了，道德意识就会扬弃自身。
因为道德只是作为否定性本质的道德意识，对它的纯粹义务来说，感性只有一种否定的意义，只是不合乎而已。
但在和谐中，道德作为意识、或者说道德的现实性消失了，正如在道德意识中、或者说在现实性中，道德的和谐消失了一样。
因此，这种完成并不是现实地可以达到的，而只能被设想为一项绝对的任务，也就是说，被设想为一项无条件地仍然是任务的任务。
但同时，它的内容又必须被设想为这样一种东西：它无条件地必须存在，而不停留在任务上；不管人们在这个目的中把意识设想为完全被扬弃了，还是并非如此；究竟实际上应当怎样看待它，在无限性的幽暗远方——目的的达到正因为如此才被推向那里——已经不能再清楚地分辨了。
本来必须说，那特定的表象不应引起兴趣，也不应被寻求，因为这会导致矛盾，——导致一项应当仍然是任务、却又应当被完成的任务的矛盾，导致一种不应再是意识、不应再是现实的道德的矛盾。
但是，通过这样的考察，即完成了的道德会包含矛盾，道德本质的神圣性就会受损，绝对义务就会显现为某种非现实的东西。

en: The first postulate was the harmony of morality and objective nature, the final end of the world; the other was the harmony of morality and the sensuous will, the final end of self-consciousness as such; the first therefore the harmony in the form of being-in-itself, the other in the form of being-for-itself.
But what connects these two extreme final ends, which are thought, as middle term, is the movement of actual acting itself.

They are harmonies whose moments have not yet become object in their abstract distinctness; this happens in actuality, in which the sides appear in consciousness proper, each as the other of the other.
The postulates arising through this now contain harmonies that are in and for themselves, just as previously [they contained] only the separated harmonies, [one] in-itself and [the other] for-itself.
zh: 第一个公设是道德与对象性自然的和谐，即世界的终极目的；另一个公设是道德与感性意志的和谐，即自我意识本身的终极目的；所以第一个是以自在存在的形式出现的和谐，另一个是以自为存在的形式出现的和谐。
但是，把这两个被设想的极端终极目的作为中项联结起来的，是现实行动本身的运动。
它们是种种和谐，其各个环节在其抽象的区别中还没有成为对象；这发生在现实性中，在现实性中，各个面在真正的意识里出现，每一面都作为另一面的另一面而出现。
由此产生的这些公设现在包含的是自在自为地存在着的和谐，正如先前它们只包含那些分离的、自在存在和自为存在着的和谐一样。

en: Moral consciousness, as the simple knowing and willing of pure duty, is in acting related to the object opposed to its simplicity, to the actuality of the manifold case, and thereby has a manifold moral relation.
Here there arise, according to content, the many laws in general, and according to form, the contradictory powers of knowing consciousness and of the unconscious.

– As regards first the many duties, only the pure duty in them counts for moral consciousness in general; the many duties as many are determinate and therefore as such nothing holy for moral consciousness.

But at the same time, necessary through the concept of acting, which includes in itself a manifold actuality and therefore a manifold moral relation, they must be considered as being in and for themselves.
Since they further can be only in a moral consciousness, they are at the same time in another than that one, for which only pure duty as the pure is in and for itself and holy.
zh: 道德意识作为对纯粹义务的单纯的知和意欲，在行动中与它的单纯性相对立的对象、与形形色色的情况的现实性发生关系，并因此具有一种多方面的道德关系。
在这里，就内容而言产生了那许多一般的法则，就形式而言产生了知晓着的意识与无意识东西的相互矛盾的势力。
——首先就这许多义务而言，在它们之中，对一般道德意识来说有效的只是纯粹义务；这许多义务作为许多，是特定的，因此作为这样的东西对道德意识来说不是什么神圣的东西。
但同时，由于行动的概念——行动自身包含一种多方面的现实性，因而包含一种多方面的道德关系——，它们是必然的，所以必须把它们看作自在自为地存在着的。
又因为它们只能存在于一个道德意识之中，所以它们同时存在于另一个不同于前者的道德意识之中，对后者来说，只有纯粹义务作为纯粹义务才是自在自为的、神圣的。

en: It is therefore postulated that there is another consciousness which sanctifies them, or which knows and wills them as duties.
The first keeps pure duty indifferent toward all determinate content, and duty is only this indifference toward it.

But the other contains the equally essential relation to action and the necessity of determinate content; since the duties count for it as determinate duties, the content as such is thereby just as essential for it as the form through which it is duty.
This consciousness is thereby one in which the universal and the particular are absolutely one, its concept therefore the same as the concept of the harmony of morality and happiness.
For this opposition likewise expresses the separation of the self-same moral consciousness from actuality, which as manifold being conflicts with the simple essence of duty.

If, however, the first postulate only expresses the existing harmony of morality and nature, because nature in it is this negative of self-consciousness, the moment of being, then, on the other hand, this in-itself is now essentially posited as consciousness.
For what is now has the form of the content of duty, or is the determinacy on determinate duty.
The in-itself is therefore the unity of such [beings] as are simple essences, essences of thought, and therefore are only in a consciousness.
This is therefore now a master and ruler of the world, who brings forth the harmony of morality and happiness and at the same time sanctifies the duties as many.

The latter means as much as that for the consciousness of pure duty the determinate duty cannot be immediately holy; but because it is, for the sake of actual action, which is a determinate one, likewise necessary, its necessity falls outside that consciousness into another, which is thus the mediating element of determinate and pure duty and the ground that the former too holds good.
zh: 所以，另一个意识是被公设出来的，它使这些义务神圣化，或者它把这些义务作为义务来知和意欲。
前者把纯粹义务保持在一种对一切确定内容都漠不关心的状态中，而义务就只是这种对内容的漠不关心。
但后者则包含对行动的那种同样本质性的关系，以及确定内容的必然性；既然在它看来这些义务作为确定的义务而有效，那么对它来说，内容本身就与那种使内容成为义务的形式同样本质。
这个意识由此就是这样一个意识，在其中普遍的东西和特殊的东西绝对是同一个东西，所以它的概念与道德和幸福的和谐这一概念是同一个概念。
因为这个对立同样表达出自身等同的道德意识与现实性的分离，而现实性作为杂多的存在与义务的单纯本质相抵触。
但是，如果说第一个公设只表达出道德与自然的存在着的和谐，因为自然在其中就是自我意识的这个否定物、即存在的环节，那么与此相反，这个自在现在就本质地被设定为意识。
因为存在者现在具有义务的内容这一形式，或者说，它就是确定义务上的规定性。
所以，自在就是那些作为单纯的本质、作为思想的本质、因而只存在于一个意识之中的东西的统一。
所以，这个意识现在就是世界的主人和统治者，它产生出道德与幸福的和谐，同时又使那些义务作为众多的义务而神圣化。
后一种说法无非意味着，对纯粹义务的意识来说，确定的义务不可能直接就是神圣的；但是，由于它为了现实的行动——这种行动是确定的——同样也是必然的，所以它的必然性就落到那个意识之外，落入另一个意识，而后者因此就是确定义务与纯粹义务的中介者，并且是前者也同样有效的根据。

en: In actual action, however, consciousness conducts itself as this self, as a completely singular one; it is directed upon actuality as such and has it as its end; for it wants to accomplish.
Thus duty in general falls outside it into another essence, which is consciousness and the holy lawgiver of pure duty.

For the acting consciousness, precisely because it is acting, the other of pure duty holds good immediately; pure duty, however, is the content of another consciousness and is holy for this acting consciousness only mediately, namely in this other consciousness.
zh: 但在现实的行动中，意识却是作为这个自我、作为一个完全个别的东西而行动的；它指向现实性本身，并且把现实性当作目的；因为它要完成。
所以，义务一般而言就落到它之外，落入另一个本质，而这个本质是意识，并且是纯粹义务的神圣立法者。
对行动着的意识来说，正因为它行动着，纯粹义务的他者就直接有效；而纯粹义务则是另一个意识的内容，并且只是间接地、即在这个意识之中，才对这个行动着的意识是神圣的。

en: Since it is hereby posited that the validity of duty as the holy in and for itself falls outside actual consciousness, this consciousness thereby stands on one side in general as the imperfect moral consciousness.
Thus, as regards its knowing, it knows itself as one whose knowing and conviction are incomplete and contingent; likewise, as regards its willing, as one whose ends are affected by sensuousness.
On account of its unworthiness it can therefore regard happiness not as necessary but as something contingent, and can expect it only from grace.
zh: 由于义务作为自在自为地神圣的东西的有效性落在现实意识之外，这一点由此被设定下来，所以这个意识因此一般而言就作为不完善的道德意识站在一边。
所以，就它的知识而言，它知道自己是这样一种意识，其知识和确信都不完整、都是偶然的；同样，就它的意欲而言，它知道自己是这样一种意识，其目的受到了感性的影响。
由于它不配得，所以它不能把幸福看作必然的东西，而只能把它看作某种偶然的东西，并且只能出于恩典来期待它。

en: But although its actuality is imperfect, for its pure will and knowing duty still counts as the essence; in the concept, insofar as the latter is opposed to reality, or in thought, this consciousness is therefore perfect.

The absolute essence, however, is precisely this thought thing and what is postulated beyond actuality; it is therefore the thought in which the morally imperfect knowing and willing counts as perfect, and thereby too, in that it takes the same as fully valid, apportions happiness according to worthiness, namely according to the merit ascribed to it.
zh: 但是，尽管它的现实性是不完善的，在它的纯粹意志和知识看来，义务却仍然作为本质而有效；所以在概念中——只要概念与实在性相对立——，或者说在思维中，这个意识就是完善的。
但绝对本质恰恰就是这个被思维的东西、这个被公设到现实性彼岸的东西；所以它就是那种思想，在其中，道德上不完善的知识和意欲被视为完善的，并且它由此——由于它把这种知识和意欲看作完全有分量的——也就按照配得、即按照归给这种知识和意欲的功绩来分配幸福。

en: The world-view is herein completed; for in the concept of moral self-consciousness the two sides, pure duty and actuality, are posited in a unity, and thereby the one as well as the other is posited not as being in and for itself but as moment or as sublated.

This becomes [so] for consciousness in the last part of the moral world-view; namely, it posits pure duty into another essence than it is itself, i.e. it posits it partly as something represented, partly as something that is not what holds in and for itself, but rather the non-moral counts as perfect.
Likewise it posits itself as one whose actuality, which is inadequate to duty, is sublated and, as sublated or in the representation of the absolute essence, no longer contradicts morality.
zh: 世界观在这里就完成了；因为在道德自我意识的概念中，两个方面，即纯粹义务和现实性，被设定在一个统一之中，并且由此一方和另一方都不是作为自在自为地存在着的，而是作为环节，或者作为被扬弃的。
在道德世界观的最后一部分里，这一点对意识来说就出现了；也就是说，它把纯粹义务设定到另一个不同于它自身的本质里，也就是说，它把纯粹义务一部分设定为一个被表象的东西，一部分设定为这样一个东西，即它不是自在自为地有效的东西，相反，非道德的东西倒被视为完善的。
同样，它把自身设定为这样一个东西，它的现实性——这种现实性与义务不相称——是被扬弃了的，并且作为被扬弃的现实性、或者说在绝对本质的表象中，不再与道德相矛盾。

en: For moral consciousness itself, however, its moral world-view does not have the meaning that it develops its own concept in it and makes it into an object for itself; it has neither a consciousness of this opposition of form nor of the opposition according to content, whose parts it does not relate to one another and compare, but in its development rolls itself onward without being the holding-together concept of the moments.
For it knows the pure essence or the object only insofar as it is duty, insofar as it is the abstract object of its pure consciousness, as pure knowing or as itself.
It therefore conducts itself only thinkingly, not comprehending.
Hence the object of its actual consciousness is not yet transparent to it; it is not the absolute concept, which alone grasps otherness as such, or its absolute opposite, as itself.

Its own actuality as well as all objective actuality indeed counts for it as the unessential; but its freedom is the freedom of pure thinking, over against which nature has therefore at the same time arisen as something equally free.

Because both are in it in the same way, the freedom of being and the being-enclosed of the same in consciousness, its object is [taken] as a being that at the same time is only thought; in the last part of its intuition the content is essentially posited in such a way that its being is a represented one, and this connection of being and thinking is expressed as what it in fact is, representation.
zh: 但对道德意识本身来说，它的道德世界观并不具有这样的含义，即它在其中展开自己的概念，并把这个概念变成自己的对象；它既没有对形式方面的这种对立的意识，也没有对内容方面的对立的意识，它并不把内容方面的这种对立的各个部分相互关联和比较，而是在自己的发展中向前滚动，同时却不是把诸环节维系起来的概念。
因为它只把纯粹本质或对象——只要它是义务，只要它是它纯粹意识的抽象对象——知为纯粹的知识，或者知为它自身。
所以，它只是思维着，而不是以概念把握着。
因此，它现实意识的对象对它来说还不是透明的；它并不是绝对概念，只有绝对概念才把他在本身、或者把它的绝对对立面把握为它自身。
它自己的现实性以及一切对象性的现实性，在它看来固然是非本质的东西；但它的自由是纯粹思维的自由，而自然因此也就同时作为同样自由的东西与这种自由相对而产生了。
因为两者以同样的方式在它之中，即存在的自由和存在被封闭在意识之中，所以它的对象就被看作一个存在着的、同时却只是被思维的对象；在它直观的最后一部分里，内容本质上被这样设定，即它的存在是一个被表象的存在，而这种存在与思维的结合则被表达为它实际上所是的东西，即表象。

en: If we consider the moral world-view in such a way that this objective mode is nothing other than the concept of moral self-consciousness itself, which the latter makes objective to itself, then there results, through this consciousness about the form of its origin, another shape of its exposition.
– The first thing, namely, from which the start is made is actual moral self-consciousness, or that there is such a thing.

For the concept posits it in the determination that for it all actuality in general has essence only insofar as it is in accordance with duty, and it posits this essence as knowledge, i.e. in immediate unity with the actual self; this unity is thus itself actual, it is a moral actual consciousness.
– This, now, as consciousness, represents its content to itself as object, namely as the final end of the world, as the harmony of morality and all actuality.

But since it represents this unity as object and is not yet the concept that has power over the object as such, this unity is for it a negative of self-consciousness, or it falls outside it, as a beyond of its actuality, but at the same time as something that is also taken as existing, but only thought.
zh: 当我们这样来看道德世界观，即这种对象性的方式无非就是道德自我意识自身的概念，而它把这个概念造成对象性的，那么通过这种关于它的起源形式的意识，就产生出它的表述的另一种形态。
——首先，出发点就是现实的道德自我意识，或者说，有这样一种东西。
因为概念把它设定在这样的规定中：对它来说，一切现实性一般而言都只有在合乎义务时才有本质，而概念又把这个本质设定为知识，也就是设定为与现实的自我处在直接的统一之中；所以这种统一本身就是现实的，它是一种道德的现实意识。
——现在，这个东西作为意识，把自己的内容表象为对象，也就是表象为世界的最终目的，表象为道德与一切现实性的和谐。
但是，由于它把这种统一表象为对象，并且还不是那种对对象本身拥有权力的概念，所以这种统一对它来说就是自我意识的一个否定物，或者说，它落到它之外，成为它的现实性的一个彼岸，但同时又是这样一个东西：它也被当作存在着的，不过只是被思考的。

en: What thus remains for it, which as self-consciousness is an other than the object, is the non-harmony of the consciousness of duty and of actuality, and indeed of its own actuality.

The proposition therefore now runs thus: there is no morally completed actual self-consciousness; and since the moral as such only is insofar as it is completed – for duty is the pure unmixed in-itself, and morality consists only in the adequateness to this pure element –, the second proposition states in general that there is no morally actual being.
zh: 对它来说，那个作为自我意识而与对象不同的东西，由此所剩下来的，就是义务意识与现实性的不和谐，而且就是它自己的现实性的不和谐。
所以这个命题现在是这样说的：没有道德上完成了的现实自我意识；而由于道德的东西一般而言只有在完成了的情况下才存在——因为义务是纯粹的、未混杂的自在，而道德只在于与这种纯粹东西相符合——所以第二个命题一般而言就是说：没有道德上现实的东西。

en: But since, thirdly, it is a self, it is in itself the unity of duty and actuality; this unity therefore becomes object for it, as completed morality, – but as a beyond of its actuality, – but one that is nevertheless supposed to be actual.
zh: 但是，由于它第三点是一个自我，所以它自在地就是义务与现实性的统一；因此这种统一就成为它的对象，作为完成了的道德，——但却是作为它现实性的一个彼岸，——然而这个彼岸却应当是现实的。

en: In this goal of the synthetic unity of the two first propositions, self-conscious actuality as well as duty is posited only as a sublated moment; for neither is singular, but they, in whose essential determination it lies to be free of the other, are thus each in the unity no longer free of the other, hence each is sublated, and thus as to content they become object as such, each of which counts for the other, and as to form in such a way that this exchange of them is at the same time only represented.
– Or the actually non-moral, because it is likewise pure thinking and raised above its actuality, is in representation nevertheless moral and is taken as fully valid.

Thereby the first proposition, that there is a moral self-consciousness, is restored, but combined with the second, that there is none, namely there is one, but only in representation; or there is indeed none, but it is nevertheless allowed by another to count as such.
zh: 在这两个最初命题的综合的统一这个目的中，自我意识着的现实性以及义务都只被设定为被扬弃的环节；因为两者都不是单个的，但它们——其本质规定就在于不依赖于另一个——所以在统一中每一个都不再不依赖于另一个，因此每一个都被扬弃了，于是它们按照内容就成为这样的对象：其中每一个都代替另一个而有效，而按照形式则是这样：它们两者的这种互换同时只是被表象的。
——或者说，现实上非道德的东西，因为它同样是纯粹的思想并且超越于自己的现实性之上，所以在表象中毕竟是道德的，并被当作完全有效的。
由此，第一个命题——有道德自我意识——就被重新建立起来，但却是与第二个命题结合在一起的，即没有这种东西，也就是说，有这种东西，但只在表象中；或者说，确实没有这种东西，但它毕竟被另一个东西容许算作这种东西。
